module_summary: AXI-Lite read-channel clock-domain crossing: slave- and master-side 3-state FSMs exchange a four-phase flag handshake via two-flop synchronizers, holding address and read data in registers.

anchors.name: s_state_reg
anchors.why: Slave-domain FSM: request, wait for master flag, return response.

anchors.name: m_state_reg
anchors.why: Master-domain FSM: issue read, capture response, release flag.

anchors.name: s_flag_reg
anchors.why: Slave-to-master request flag crossing into m_clk domain.

anchors.name: m_flag_reg
anchors.why: Master-to-slave completion flag crossing into s_clk domain.

anchors.name: s_flag_sync_reg_2
anchors.why: Synchronized request flag steering master FSM transitions.

anchors.name: m_flag_sync_reg_2
anchors.why: Synchronized completion flag steering slave FSM transitions.

anchors.name: s_axil_arvalid
anchors.why: Slave read address valid, captured into s_axil_arvalid_reg.

anchors.name: s_axil_arready
anchors.why: Slave read address ready when no request or response pending.

anchors.name: s_axil_araddr
anchors.why: Slave read address latched into s_axil_araddr_reg.

anchors.name: s_axil_rdata
anchors.why: Read data returned to slave side from s_axil_rdata_reg.

anchors.name: s_axil_rvalid
anchors.why: Slave read response valid from s_axil_rvalid_reg.

anchors.name: m_axil_araddr
anchors.why: Master read address forwarded from crossed address register.

anchors.name: m_axil_arvalid
anchors.why: Master read address valid driven by m_axil_arvalid_reg.

anchors.name: m_axil_rdata
anchors.why: Master read data captured into m_axil_rdata_reg.

anchors.name: s_axil_araddr_reg
anchors.why: Holds request address across the CDC handshake for master side.

anchors.name: m_axil_rdata_reg
anchors.why: Holds read data until slave FSM copies it across domains.

anchors.name: s_axil_arvalid_reg
anchors.why: Pending request flag starting slave FSM and blocking arready.

anchors.name: m_axil_rvalid_reg
anchors.why: Response captured flag advancing master FSM and gating rready.

groups.name: Slave-side controller
groups.description: s_clk FSM raising request flag and returning response.

groups.name: Master-side controller
groups.description: m_clk FSM issuing read and signalling completion.

groups.name: Address crossing
groups.description: Latched read address and prot carried to master domain.

groups.name: Read data crossing
groups.description: Captured read data and resp carried back to slave domain.
